skills.label: Your account
skills.desc: Check your own account details, usage limits, and active sessions. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/account/overview

skills.label: Account
skills.desc: Use this page to confirm that you are signed in as the right person and to see what access you have been given. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/account/profile

skills.label: Sessions
skills.desc: Use this page to see every place you are currently signed in to Claude for Government and to sign out of any of them remotely. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/account/sessions

skills.label: Usage
skills.desc: Use this page to see how much of your Claude allowance you have used and when it refreshes. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/account/usage

skills.label: How Config works
skills.desc: Understand how product settings in Claude for Government are resolved across the tenant, directory groups, and organizations, and how to find, change, compare, and lock them. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/config/overview

skills.label: Manage plugins and connectors
skills.desc: Choose between plugins and connectors in Claude for Government, prepare plugin archives for upload, decide how plugins install for members, update and remove plugins, and understand how connector tool policies apply to members. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/config/plugins-and-connectors

skills.label: Available settings
skills.desc: Config page settings in Claude for Government, such as session timeouts, network and folder access, tool approvals, connectors, plugins, telemetry, and updates. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/config/settings

skills.label: Set up the Microsoft 365 connector
skills.desc: Register an application in your Microsoft Entra tenant so that Claude Desktop can read your agency's Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams content on each member's behalf. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/connectors/microsoft-365

skills.label: Connectors
skills.desc: Add Model Context Protocol servers for your own systems, choose which Claude products receive each one, and set which of their tools are available to members. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/connectors/overview

skills.label: Connect Claude Code to Claude for Government
skills.desc: Deploy the managed settings that send the Claude Code command-line tool to Claude for Government sign-in, limit what it contacts before a user signs in, and verify the result on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/deploy-claude-code/configure

skills.label: Connect Claude Desktop to Claude for Government
skills.desc: Choose between single-machine setup and fleet deployment, understand the administrator requirements for each, and connect Claude Desktop to Claude for Government. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/deploy-desktop/configure

skills.label: Windows fleet checklist
skills.desc: Device, installer, virtualization, policy, network, and account prerequisites to confirm before deploying Claude Desktop across a Windows fleet for Claude for Government. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/deploy-desktop/windows-checklist

skills.label: Deploy Claude for Microsoft 365 in Claude for Government
skills.desc: Download the Claude for Microsoft 365 manifest from your Claude for Government host and deploy the add-in to users from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/deploy-microsoft-365/configure

skills.label: Import your data from Claude for Government Web
skills.desc: Copy your conversations, projects, and files from Claude for Government Web into Claude Desktop. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/desktop/import

skills.label: Models in Claude Desktop
skills.desc: Switch models in Claude Desktop on Claude for Government, see what the 1M context window does, and find what controls which models you see. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/desktop/models

skills.label: Plugins in Claude Desktop
skills.desc: Find, install, create, and remove plugins in Claude Desktop for Claude for Government, and understand what plugins add in this deployment. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/desktop/plugins

skills.label: Skills in Claude Desktop
skills.desc: What skills are in Claude for Government, where they come from, how to create and manage your own, and how administrators distribute skills to members. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/desktop/skills

skills.label: Video walkthroughs for Claude Desktop
skills.desc: Watch short narrated walkthroughs of signing in to Claude Desktop with Claude for Government, bringing your work over, and finding your way around the app. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/desktop/video-walkthroughs

skills.label: Analytics
skills.desc: Use this page to review requests, tokens, spend, top users, and credit balance over time across your organization, and to download the data as CSV files for offline reporting. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/analytics

skills.label: Billing
skills.desc: Use this page to see the balance your organization spends from and any spend caps set on it, and to adjust your organization's seat allocation. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/billing

skills.label: Compliance API
skills.desc: Stream your organization's audit events into a SIEM or log management system. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/compliance-api

skills.label: Config at the organization level
skills.desc: View and change the product settings that apply to everyone in your organization, and see where each effective value comes from. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/configuration

skills.label: Organization administration
skills.desc: Manage the people, seats, and settings for a single organization within your agency. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/overview

skills.label: Group mappings
skills.desc: Use this page to map the groups pushed from your identity provider to seat tiers and roles in this organization. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/provisioning

skills.label: Readiness
skills.desc: Use this page to see everything that is stopping people in your organization from using Claude, and where each blocker is resolved. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/readiness

skills.label: Seat tiers
skills.desc: Use this page to see the models and spend limits attached to each tier and, when permitted, to create and edit self-managed tiers. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/seat-tiers

skills.label: Seats
skills.desc: Use this page to check your organization's seat counts at a glance before assigning or reclaiming seats on the Users page. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/seats

skills.label: Setup wizard
skills.desc: Walk through the steps that get your organization ready for users after a tenant administrator creates it. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/setup-wizard

skills.label: Users
skills.desc: Use this page to find a user, change their role or seat tier, check how close they are to their usage limits, and reset those limits when needed. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/org-admin/users

skills.label: Claude for Government changelog
skills.desc: Release notes for Claude for Government Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/changelog

skills.label: Moving from Claude for Government Web
skills.desc: Find answers to the questions agencies ask most often when moving from Claude for Government Web to Claude Desktop. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/moving-from-web

skills.label: Claude for Government administrator guide
skills.desc: Set up and manage Claude for Government for your agency: how tenants, organizations, users, seats, and credits fit together. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/overview

skills.label: Video walkthroughs for administrators
skills.desc: Watch short narrated walkthroughs of setting up and running Claude for Government for your agency. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/video-walkthroughs

skills.label: Security and data handling
skills.desc: Answers for agency security review: sandbox isolation, network egress and required domains, approvals, connector credentials, telemetry, and where data is stored. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/security/security-and-data-handling

skills.label: Admins
skills.desc: Use this page to view, add, and remove the people who can use the tenant admin portal. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/admins

skills.label: Config at the tenant level
skills.desc: Set tenant-wide defaults for product behavior, lock settings so organizations can't change them, and preview how a change affects each organization. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/configuration

skills.label: Billing
skills.desc: Use this page to see each billing account's balance and to set per-organization spend caps. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/credits

skills.label: Identity and access
skills.desc: Connect single sign-on, manage SCIM provisioning, and write the routing rules that place users into organizations. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/identity-and-access

skills.label: Organizations
skills.desc: Use this page to see every organization in your tenant, open any organization's admin view, and create new organizations. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/organizations

skills.label: Tenant administration
skills.desc: Manage the settings that apply across your whole agency: organizations, identity and sign-in, and how seats are distributed and spend caps are set. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/overview

skills.label: Readiness
skills.desc: Use this page to see everything that is blocking your organizations from using Claude, and to find the one place where each blocker is resolved. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/readiness

skills.label: Seats
skills.desc: Use this page to divide each billing account's seat pool among the organizations that account funds. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/seats

skills.label: Tenant setup wizard
skills.desc: Walk through the guided setup that takes a brand new tenant from first sign-in to ready for users. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/setup-wizard

skills.label: Tenant restrictions
skills.desc: Restrict which Claude for Government tenants can be reached from your agency's network by having your network proxy inject an allowlist header. Source: https://claude.com/docs/government/tenant-admin/tenant-restrictions
